explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in body context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token, I compared the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` against the keyword and wrapped the token’s normalized serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>` when it matched, leaving special-element opener text, comments, and other non-text tokens untouched.
